headline: Chegg Misses Third-Quarter Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Chegg Inc reported third-quarter earnings that missed consensus projections by $0.01, accompanied by revenue that fell short of estimates.
why: Chegg is an educational technology company that provides digital and physical textbook rentals, online tutoring, and other student services, making its financial results indicative of demand for online education.

impacts.name: Chegg Inc
impacts.why: Missing both earnings and revenue forecasts directly undermines investor confidence in the company's financial trajectory.
